Mcs/VoiceEnabled Description: Enable Assistant voice command recognition (STT + LLM). Required to use voice control over AI escorts.
Mcs/VoiceTriggerMode Description: Trigger mode: PushToTalk holds a key to talk; FreeTalk auto-records via VAD without key.
Mcs/VoiceHotKey Description: Hotkey for PushToTalk mode. Ignored under FreeTalk.
Mcs/VoiceCaptureMaxSeconds Description: Maximum single recording length in seconds. Long phrases are cut at this limit.
Mcs/VoiceVadEnergyThreshold Description: RMS energy threshold that triggers speech start in FreeTalk. Lower if whispers are ignored.
Mcs/VoiceVadSilenceSeconds Description: Silence duration to end the recording in FreeTalk.
Mcs/VoiceFeedbackSubtitles Description: Show in-game notification after each voice command is dispatched.
Mcs/RecordDevice Description: Select the recording device used for voice recognition; Default means the system default device. If the list is empty, check your microphone devices in system settings.
Mcs/HttpProxyHost Description: HTTP proxy hostname or IP used by LLM/STT requests (e.g. 127.0.0.1); empty means direct connection. When configured, all requests (including local addresses) go through the proxy.
Mcs/HttpProxyPort Description: HTTP proxy port (e.g. 7890); must be configured together with the proxy host, empty means direct connection.
Mcs/SttDebugEnabled Description: When enabled, records and transcribes using the current configuration; the transcribed text overwrites the STT debug text field.
Mcs/SttDebugText Description: The latest transcription result of a recording.
Mcs/LlmDebugSend Description: Sends the STT debug text to the LLM for testing; the reply or error overwrites the LLM result field.
Mcs/LlmDebugResult Description: The latest reply or error message of an LLM test.
Mcs/LlmDebugAutoEnabled Description: When enabled, after STT transcription in debug mode, automatically calls the LLM for command recognition testing; the result is shown in 'Command Recognition Result'.
Mcs/LlmDebugAutoResult Description: The latest automatic command recognition result, showing what command the LLM would actually call.
Mcs/SttApiKey Description: API key for the chosen STT provider.
Mcs/SttBaseUrl Description: Optional custom STT base URL (overrides per-provider default).
Mcs/SttModelId Description: Optional STT model name (provider-specific). Leave blank for default.
Mcs/SttLanguage Description: Hint language code in BCP-47 (e.g. zh-CN, en-US, ja-JP) for STT.
Mcs/LlmProvider Description: Cloud LLM provider; OpenAI-Compatible covers OpenAI / DeepSeek / Moonshot / Ollama / vLLM etc.
Mcs/LlmApiKey Description: API key for the chosen LLM provider.
Mcs/LlmBaseUrl Description: Optional custom LLM base URL (overrides per-provider default for OpenAI-Compatible).
Mcs/LlmModelId Description: LLM model name. Provider-specific; default deepseek-v4-flash for OpenAI-Compatible.
Mcs/LlmSystemPrompt Description: Optional custom system prompt prepended to Assistant's voice-command instruction template.
Mcs/LlmTemperature Description: LLM sampling temperature, 0..2. Lower is more deterministic.
Mcs/LlmMaxTokens Description: Maximum tokens LLM may emit. Affects cost/latency.
Mcs/VoiceProviderMissing: A STT/LLM provider is not configured.
Mcs/VoiceDebugPlay Description: Play back the most recent voice recording (debug playback; requires a successful recording first)
Mcs/VoiceDebugVadText Description: Live speech detection status for FreeTalk (RMS energy / speech flag / silence timer). Read-only.
Mcs/LlmReasoningEffort Description: LLM reasoning effort: default / low / medium / high / max. Options are provided only; whether this model supports it depends on the actual endpoint. default omits the parameter; unsupported models usually ignore it.
Mcs/SttApiSecret Description: Second key (secret/token) for two-key providers (Xfyun/Tencent/Baidu/Volc/Aliyun); leave empty for single-key providers.
Mcs/LlmPingNotSupported: This provider does not support Ping test
Mcs/SttAliyunRequired: Aliyun NLS requires SttApiKey (AccessKeyId), SttApiSecret (AccessKeySecret) and SttModelId (appkey)
Mcs/SttAliyunAppId: Aliyun NLS requires appkey in SttModelId
Mcs/SttAliyunToken: Aliyun NLS token exchange failed (check AccessKeyId/AccessKeySecret)
Mcs/SttTencentRequired: Tencent Cloud requires SttApiKey (SecretId) and SttApiSecret (SecretKey)
